subject: calling something after a shiny callback is done

messages.author: e52b48f39d670ebd
messages.subject: calling something after a shiny callback is done
parts:
Hi,

I have a rather simple question. I am using the action button to modify my target elements once all the inputs are done. This works wonderfully.

Now I want to trigger off some javascript after I get my results. The trouble is that jQuery's onchange does not bind to divs/images, etc. If I attach it to the click on the action button, it gets called before shiny and therefore, does not work as desired.

Ideal solution is to trigger this function after shiny has finished doing what it does after the action button.

Many thanks...

messages.author: e52b48f39d670ebd
messages.subject: Re: calling something after a shiny callback is done
parts:
got a little bit further.. I added the highlighted line in shiny.js -

  var htmlOutputBinding = new OutputBinding();
  $.extend(htmlOutputBinding, {
    find: function(scope) {
      return $(scope).find('.shiny-html-output');
    },
    renderValue: function(el, data) {
      exports.unbindAll(el);
      $(el).html(data);
      $(el).trigger('docloaded');
      exports.bindAll(el);
    }
  });

Now from the javascript console, I can listen for that action and it works. 

$('#opBuf').on('docloaded', function() {
  console.info('Handler for opBuf called.');
});


However, if I include the same thing in my js file (I'm using index.html), then it does not work anymore. My js file is the last file being loaded, and it does run some other stuff, just not this registration. I think it might be because #opBuf has not been created yet. Any ideas on how to call it after opBuf is done?
